description: This Java source file defines the DefaultTbQueueService class, which manages queue operations such as saving, deleting, and updating queues within the Thingsboard platform. It interacts with cluster services, queue administration, and queue data storage, and handles tenant-specific queue configurations.

classes.name: DefaultTbQueueService
classes.description: Service class for managing queues, including creation, deletion, and updates, with cluster synchronization and topic management.

methods.name: saveQueue
methods.description: Saves a queue, creating topics if needed, and updates the cluster.

methods.name: deleteQueue
methods.description: Deletes a queue by tenant and queue ID, and notifies the cluster.

methods.name: deleteQueueByQueueName
methods.description: Deletes a queue by tenant and queue name, and notifies the cluster.

methods.name: updateQueuesByTenants
methods.description: Updates queues for multiple tenants based on tenant profile configuration changes, handling creation, update, and deletion.

methods.name: createTopicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates Kafka topics for a queue if the number of partitions has increased.
